title: Longway Font
author: Corgi Astronaut
description:
Longway, an all caps Serif font with a vintage touch. 
Longway is designed to be multi-functional, it works great on packaging, apparel, branding and much more. It is very legible and works great for print & web.
Language Support: English, Spanish, French and Portuguese.
